ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 25 Nov 2026 in the session that priced every module at rest ("approve poly8 0.3.4, write the approval"): release POLY8 0.3.4-experimental (#2118).
reason: 0.3.4 changes no code: runtime.json marks POLY8's 11 frame-interrupt detours "rests", so while no track of the project uses POLY8 the base leaves them on stock's bytes. On Laslo's MKII (development twin 2f0dcfa3 of base 0.8, OS 1.40C, project CPUCURVE2, package 42180899) it adds +0.0 points of the frame interrupt at rest against +1.3 for 0.3.3, the 11 sites read stock's bytes while it rests and patched after a pick on T1, and POLY8 on T1 costs as 0.3.3 (+32.3 / +47.1, 0 skipped); no stall or crash. The UI and pages are 0.2.7's, so its captures are retained. Waived for this exact source: MIDI on a channel shared with a POLY8 track, chords and held keys after a wake, a base without capability 2048, Keep and a power cycle on a unit, chip worst-case cycles and complete memory bounds.
